prompt: What will the pieces of tape help the evening team do?
promptZh: 這兩段膠帶能幫晚班同事做什麼？

options.text: Tell which side of the coat needs adjustment.
options.zh: 看出外套哪一側需要修改。
options.whyZh: 膠帶貼在鏡子的轉軸兩側，不是用來標記外套。

options.text: Restore the mirror to the chosen angle.
options.zh: 把鏡面調回選定的角度。
options.whyZh: 兩段膠帶對齊時，鏡面就回到原本選好的角度。

options.text: Show customers where to wait for a fitting.
options.zh: 告訴客人要在哪裡排隊試穿。
options.whyZh: 膠帶貼在鏡子的轉軸，不是用來標示地上的等候位置。

options.text: Identify which blind should stay closed.
options.zh: 辨認哪扇百葉窗應保持關閉。
options.whyZh: 百葉窗不關，這兩段膠帶也不是貼在百葉窗上。

explanationZh: 兩段膠帶對齊時，鏡面就回到原本選好的角度。
evidence: It would, but then the counter would be too dark. Once the mirror looks right, put one piece of tape on each side of the hinge. The evening team can line them up if someone moves it again.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: It would, but then the counter would be too dark. Once the mirror looks right, put one piece of tape on each side of the hinge. The evening team can line them up if someone moves it again.

vocabulary.note: them 指鉸鏈兩側的膠帶標記，用它們恢復鏡面角度。
